_comment: The categories an article_queue row may declare, fetched by the Article Content Writer the way the studio fetches datasets/visual_types.json. An entry's CATEGORIES is a comma-separated list of these names and nothing else, so the blog's taxonomy stays one list instead of one per draft. A row that needs a new category adds it here, in the same commit as the row.
_comment_no_placeholders: Never write a doubled-curly-brace placeholder anywhere in this file, not even inside a comment: DownloadTemplate scans the whole downloaded text for them and routes to stop_and_error for any name it was not passed, and this file is fetched with an empty template_vars.
